note: Planned, and the plan changes. This is a snapshot of breakaway’s own roadmap, taken from its board when it moves. Each release marks itself out once it ships.

features.title: Architect
features.line: The board runs the infrastructure too. Agents propose changes in pull requests; you approve each plan.

features.title: Plan features from the pace
features.line: Plan a feature’s start and end, and see from the pace when it’s likely done.

features.title: Agent conduct: review, follow-through, and sources
features.line: Habits for every agent: review its own work, answer what it’s asked, and check its sources.

features.title: Captaincy: chases that fit your day
features.line: A road captain for each chase, and chases sized to what you can review.

features.title: Compliance center
features.line: Compliance checks on your code and infrastructure, software bills of materials, and a data inventory, from the board.

features.title: Security core: a watcher for what agents do on the board
features.line: A routine that reads the board’s own activity and flags an agent working out of line.

features.title: Inference and agents on any model
features.line: Inference APIs as something Architect runs, with keys, budgets, and usage, and agents on more than one model.

features.title: Studio: brand, design, and launch for people who’d rather build
features.line: A name, a voice, a look, a site, and launch posts for each repository. Agents draft; you choose and publish.

features.title: breakaway runners
features.line: Runners on your own compute that take the board’s jobs: apply runs, CI, and later agents.

features.title: More providers
features.line: Providers after Cloudflare, one at a time, each checked end to end before the next.

features.title: Observability: metrics, logs, and traces for what Architect runs
features.line: Metrics, logs an agent can read during an incident, and traces, redacted before they reach the board.

features.title: Architect drives OpenTofu
features.line: Architect plans through OpenTofu, so any platform with a provider there can be an environment.

features.title: Artifacts
features.line: A repository for each claimed task on Cloudflare Artifacts, with its changes, checks, and a preview on the board.

features.title: breakaway git: repositories, pull requests, and CI on your own install
features.line: Host the code on your install too, with reviews and checks built for many agents at once. GitHub stays supported.
